page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i5ge.6xlarge is an x86_64 virtual instance belonging to the Local SSDs family, managed via a KVM hypervisor. The system is equipped with 24 dedicated vCPUs driven by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at a clock speed of 3.2 GHz. The memory subsystem provides 144.0 GB of RAM, equating to an allocation of 6.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware acceleration via discrete GPUs is not present in this configuration.

Storage architecture is defined by an integrated 3839 GB local solid-state drive (SSD), which delivers direct disk access without the latency associated with network-attached block volumes. Complementing the local storage subsystem, the instance features a baseline network bandwidth of 50 Gbps, enabling efficient data transfer across distributed topologies. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default.

The resource profile delivers high qualitative cost efficiency for input-output intensive workloads by bundling substantial local non-volatile storage alongside dedicated compute cores and high network capacity. The architecture presents an intentional operational tradeoff: while local SSD storage optimizes disk I/O performance, it lacks the decoupling and independent lifecycle management of centralized network storage. The instance is suited for distributed NoSQL databases, transactional relational databases, large-scale search engines, and real-time log analytics.
